notes.title: Patch Notes Version 1.01
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.01 for PC and Mac available now:[/h1]

[list]
[*][h2]Fix default key binding, use Q/R rather than mouse wheel to change the channel, and use L instead of Q to toggle laser.[/h2]
[*][h2]Remove the "unlimited" option in the FPS setting.[/h2]
[*][h2]Remove crosshair according to the feedback.[/h2]
[*][h2]Enable laser by default and keep it on between levels.[/h2]
[*][h2]Character is more likely to slide down the cube when stepping on it and applying antigravity to it. [/h2]
[*][h2]Adjust the respawn location in level 17.[/h2]
[*][h2]Adjust the controller location in level 20.[/h2]
[/list]
